purpose: Exercise ESM exports, nested format composition, metadata, and declarations without importing candidate JavaScript into the trusted node:test process.

operations.evaluate: Evaluate a bounded literal/concat/style expression against either named exports or the default namespace under an explicit FORCE_COLOR value.
operations.metadata: Return a bounded projection of package metadata, runtime export names, and declaration names.

adapter_notes: The trusted test process constructs only bounded JSON expressions.
A fixed inline child adapter reads and imports the installed candidate as UID 10001.
The child environment is rebuilt from an allowlist and removes NODE_OPTIONS, NODE_PATH, npm registry, proxy, and loader variables.
Every request starts a new process, preventing import-time color state or candidate mutations from crossing leaves.
